description: R-PAR-1 fixture r-par-1-fold2: DG(d 0..15) and NUM(n 1..4096, inserted ascending from the cross join DG x DG x DG); FO(id Long PK, k Long indexed IX_FO_K, d Double) with three rows inserted as (id 2, k 3, d 2^53), (id 3, k 1, d 1), (id 1, k 2, d -2^53), so that insertion, primary-key and k order differ; FOI(id PK, g, d) with three groups interleaved in storage (g1 [9007199254740992, 1, -9007199254740992]; g2 [-9007199254740992, 9007199254740992, 1]; g3 [1, 9007199254740992, -9007199254740992]; ids 1-9 in insertion order) and FOV (the same rows, ids 9 down to 1, index IX_FOV_G on g); FL(id Counter PK, g, d): g1 one 2^53 then 4096 rows of 1, g2 4096 rows of 1 then one 2^53, g3 one 2^53, 4096 rows of 1, then -2^53 (inserted in that order), and FLI (the same rows, indexes IX_FLI_G on g and IX_FLI_D on d); FG(id Counter PK, g, d): 4096 groups, each as three rows [2^53, 1, -2^53], the groups interleaved (all 2^53 rows, then all 1 rows, then all -2^53 rows), and FGI (the same rows, index IX_FGI_G); FN (Null-mixed Double groups); FS (Single groups); FC (Currency groups at and near the type limits: g1 [922337203685477.5807, 0.0001, -0.0001]; g2 [922337203685477.5807, 1, -1]; g3 [-1, 1, 922337203685477.5807]; g4 [1, 922337203685477.5807, -1]; g5 [922337203685477.5807, 922337203685477.5807]; g6 [-922337203685477.5808, -1, 1]; g7 [0.0001, 0.0002, 0.0003]; g8 [922337203685477.5807, -922337203685477.5808, 1]; g9 [0.0001, 0.0002]; g10 [100000000.0001, 100000000.0003]; g11 [-922337203685477.5808, -922337203685477.5808]; g12 [0.0001, 922337203685477.5807]); FD (made through ADO DDL with Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0 as id INTEGER PK, g INTEGER, x DECIMAL(28,4), after closing the DAO database, then reopened by DAO; rows inserted as SQL numeric literals; g1 [9999999999999.9999, 0.0001, -0.0001]; g2 [9999999999999.9999, 1, -1]; g3 [-1, 1, 9999999999999.9999]; g4 [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]; g5 [99999999999999999, 1, -99999999999999999]; g6 [79228162514264337593543950335, 1, -1]; g7 [1.00000000000000000001, 1]; g8 [0.5, 0.5]). Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); DDL and set-based rows go through Database.Execute, exact typed values through table-type AddNew/Value/Update; every statement's outcome is captured (a refused statement is an observation) and a read-back follows; the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE DG (d LONG CONSTRAINT PK_DG PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE NUM (n LONG CONSTRAINT PK_NUM PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO NUM (n) SELECT a.d * 256 + b.d * 16 + c.d + 1 FROM DG AS a, DG AS b, DG AS c ORDER BY a.d, b.d, c.d
SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM NUM
CREATE TABLE FO (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FO PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FOI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FOI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FOV (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FOV PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FL (id COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_FL PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 1, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 2, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FL (g, d) SELECT 3, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE FLI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FLI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FLI (id, g, d) SELECT id, g, d FROM FL ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE FG (id COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_FG PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, 9007199254740992 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, 1 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
INSERT INTO FG (g, d) SELECT n, -9007199254740992 FROM NUM ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE FGI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FGI PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO FGI (id, g, d) SELECT id, g, d FROM FG ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE FN (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FN PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, d DOUBLE)
CREATE TABLE FS (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FS PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, s SINGLE)
CREATE TABLE FC (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_FC PRIMARY KEY, g LONG, c CURRENCY)
CREATE TABLE FD (id INTEGER CONSTRAINT PK_FD PRIMARY KEY, g INTEGER, x DECIMAL(28,4))
